integrity: Full structural proof and standalone finite checker supplied; checks do not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Classifies equality of deletion outputs within one partition and their aggregate counts; not two-source decoding confusability or capacity. The high-probability statement assumes uniform set partitions and a standard Bell-number ratio estimate. Earlier equivalent unindexed work remains a risk.
title: Exact distance-resolved collisions of one-deletion set-partition reads
